texts: Wraiths that are in the cove sometimes harm sky-cats.
When a moth-count at the Stilllight Lantern is low, sky-cats stay on the cliff-spires.

fields.sentence: Wraiths that are in the cove sometimes harm sky-cats.

review.notes: The relative-clause restriction correctly forces the distributing-rule route with (LocatedIn $x sk_cove_1) as a premise conjunct and the cove witness asserted at top level so the premise can match; "sometimes" correctly sets rule strength 0.5 and takes its QuantifierPhrase companion.

fields.sentence: When a moth-count at the Stilllight Lantern is low, sky-cats stay on the cliff-spires.
parse: (: skycat_rule (Implication (And (Member $x sky_cat) (Member $c moth_count) (LocatedIn $c stilllight_lantern) (Member $c low)) (On $x sk_spires_1)) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: continuative "stay" + locative PP — the instruction set routes it to the bare position atom and states outright that the continuation has no carrier there, so "stay on" is indistinguishable from "are on" in the output

the whenever/when-P-Q machinery ties the response to its trigger with `During` on a Skolem EVENT; when the response is a position atom rather than an eventuality there is no witness to carry that link, and no substitute tie is specified
review.notes: "the Stilllight Lantern" is correctly a name (capitalized run exceeds the bare class word) with a separate `Member ... lantern` type atom, "at" correctly takes containment `LocatedIn`, and the definite plural "the cliff-spires" correctly mints a group witness. Compound genus atoms for `moth_count`, `sky_cat` and `cliff_spire` are all present with noun modifiers left unexposed, as required.
